title: Prospective shared-host cost-fidelity value screen on the blind C4R workload
purpose: Determine whether the already blind-validated LARE representation ladder occupies a useful purpose-dependent computational cost versus hydrological fidelity frontier relative to same-partition CoRichards, FMC/SMVE and fine Reference Richards, without making a formal portable performance claim.

live_delta_reconciliation.scope: F-ROMV2 D25-D27 evidence, documentation, status and authority validation only

rossfast_disposition.reason: Current admitted RossFast production model binding accepts rossfast_d3r_forcing_t with explicit top and bottom fluxes and a state-local flux envelope. C4R/C4S use prescribed bottom head mode 5 with psi_b=0, so no admitted fixed-head RossFast route exists for this workload.

frozen_workload.identity: Exact blind C4R fixed-water-table validation workload

other.identity: fine current-canonical Reference Richards, 16 x 10 cm
other.role: direct scientific reference and timing calibration route

hydrological_fidelity_binding.LARE: Use immutable C4R result metrics without recomputation or retuning.
hydrological_fidelity_binding.CoRichards_R3_R12: Recover immutable C4S member artifacts and compute the exact C4R metric vector versus immutable C4R R16. No timing is exposed before this metric table is frozen.
hydrological_fidelity_binding.R16: Zero reference error by definition on this workload.

LARE.equations: Exact C4R BC1 CURRENT_LAYER_FACE LARE equations, 0.0001-day internal Heun step, 1e-13 theta corrector tolerance, maximum 50 corrector iterations, no clipping/fallback.
LARE.validation: For all six reduced members, reproduce immutable C4R pooled and by-history storage, cumulative-bottom, terminal-bottom-flux, mapped-theta and sign metrics.

FMC.equations: Exact frozen D13 groundwater-front FMC_GW200 route used in C4R.
FMC.validation: Reproduce immutable C4R FMC pooled and by-history metrics.

CoRichards_and_R16.validation: Benchmark-capable harness in validation mode must byte-reproduce each immutable C4S qualified per-history scientific stdout for R3-R12 and exact C4R control stdout for R2/R16.

compiled_implementation_equivalence.failure_rule: Any implementation-equivalence failure closes C4T before timing. No equation, partition, timestep, fallback class, tolerance or metric may be retuned inside C4T.

timing_protocol.compiler: GNU Fortran, all compiled scientific routes in one workflow on ubuntu-24.04
timing_protocol.primary_measure: in-process Fortran CPU_TIME around repeated complete four-history C4R workloads
timing_protocol.diagnostic_measure: external monotonic elapsed time per invocation

order.rounds_16_30: all 15 cyclic rotations of reversed base
order.property: every route occupies every measurement position exactly twice

cost_statistics.pairwise: paired CPU delta for every route pair across the 30 position-balanced rounds, with mean, sd, SE, lower and upper two-SE bounds
cost_statistics.resolved_cheaper_rule: A is resolved cheaper than B only when mean(A-B)+2*SE < 0.
cost_statistics.resolved_more_expensive_rule: A is resolved more expensive than B only when mean(A-B)-2*SE > 0.

purpose_frontier_rules.fidelity_no_worse: For the declared purpose vector, every component of route A is <= route B, using exact sign counts and 1e-12 numerical equality tolerance; at least one component must be strictly smaller for strict fidelity dominance.
purpose_frontier_rules.resolved_value_dominance: A resolved-dominates B only if A has no-worse purpose fidelity with at least one strict fidelity improvement, and A is resolved cheaper than B by the paired two-SE rule.
purpose_frontier_rules.frontier: A route remains on the resolved purpose frontier if no other route resolved-dominates it.
purpose_frontier_rules.R16_cost_gate: A reduced LARE route can support a positive computational-value signal only if it is resolved cheaper than R16.

decision_logic.C4T_LARE_PURPOSE_VALUE_SIGNAL_RESOLVED: All hard gates pass; at least one reduced LARE member is on a resolved GW or PROFILE frontier and is resolved cheaper than R16; and it is not resolved-dominated on that same purpose by FMC or any qualified CoRichards route.
decision_logic.C4T_LARE_PURPOSE_VALUE_SIGNAL_NEGATIVE: All hard gates pass; every reduced LARE member is resolved-dominated on both purpose frontiers, or no reduced LARE member has a resolved cost advantage over R16 while at least one non-LARE reduced route does.
decision_logic.C4T_LARE_PURPOSE_VALUE_SIGNAL_UNRESOLVED: All hard gates pass but timing uncertainty or incomparable fidelity prevents positive or negative adjudication.
decision_logic.C4T_IMPLEMENTATION_OR_TIMING_BLOCKED: Any authority, implementation-equivalence, checksum, calibration or timing-completion hard gate fails.

outputs: immutable purpose-fidelity table for all 15 routes
minimal LARE dimension on each retained frontier
CoRichards fallback counts carried from C4S alongside cost
